verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It establishes the base case, performs determinant-preserving column operations in the required descending order, expands along the resulting first row, factors the terms involving x_1, and applies the induction hypothesis to the remaining Vandermonde determinant. The two resulting products partition all pairs 1 <= i < j <= n. The argument covers repeated as well as distinct real inputs, uses no external references or fact IDs, and violates none of the hard prohibitions.
